system.description:
You briefly conjure a flock of floating origami above you, which rain paper needles, on an area of your choosing. Select a point you can see within range, as you fill a 20-foot cube with the rain of piercing strikes, forcing all creatures in range to make a Dexterity saving throw, dealing 3d10 piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful on.

Paper Veil. If this jutsu is cast while your Paper Veil state is active, it gains the benefit of your first Canvas Type.

Explosive Veil. After cast, the needles fill the affected area, with explosive risk. If a hostile creature moves within the affected area, before the beginning of your next turn, it detonates under them, remaking their saving throw for this jutsu, and taking 2d10 fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

Serrated Veil. On a failure, affected creature gains 2 ranks of Bleed.

Binding Veil. On a failure, the affected creature gain 2 ranks of Weakened on a failure.

Weaving Veil. On a failure, you teleport into a space affected by this jutsu, and can make one unarmed attack against a creature in range.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost by 3 and the damage by 1d10. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of the inflicted condition or the number unarmed attacks made by +1.
